candidates.title: Locus Robotics acquires Nexera Robotics, folds NeuraGrasp into Array
candidates.thesis: Official: Locus bought a grasping startup to round out Array. Real: warehouse robotics hit the picking wall, AMR vendors that can't grasp variable SKUs will get rolled up by those who can. NeuraGrasp is the first patented soft-gripper that makes Robots-to-Goods commercially defensible.
candidates.differentiates_from: Post 486 GXO/KION (floor automation/digital twins, May 26) and Post 493 Toyota (ASRS consolidation, May 29) operate at different layers. Locus/Nexera is the picking arm + software-acquisition layer.

candidates.title: Coupa acquires Rossum (IDP) + Compose/Catalyst launch at Inspire 2026

candidates.title: Redwood Logistics AI in Logistics Report - only 13% of shippers get quantifiable results
